title: Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.23917v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many structural breaks are announced in advance, yet adaptive conformal methods learn of them only from their own errors. A reset at the announced date serves one of two audits, conformal reliability of the next interval or frequency calibration of a closed window, and the two can disagree. For independent scores, restarting the empirical quantile at the boundary attains the minimax reliability rate, of order one over the square root of the post-break count. Restarting an adaptive recursion attains a frequency gap of order one over that count on bounded scores when its floor adds a bounded total. That gap bounds nothing about the next interval. After a large synthetic break, the restarted quantile's coverage error at the 50th forecast is 0.035, against 0.052 for the best of five adaptive baselines. translated_title: 预先公告的变点使保形可靠性与频率校准相分离
translated_abstract: 许多结构性变点会提前公告，然而自适应保形方法只能从自身的预测误差中获知它们。在公告日期进行重置只能服务于两种审计之一：下一区间的保形可靠性，或一个封闭窗口的频率校准，而这两者可能不一致。对于独立得分，在变点边界处重启经验分位数可以达到极小化极大（minimax）可靠性速率，其阶为断裂后样本数的平方根分之一（1/√n）。在得分有界且递归下限累计增量有界的条件下，重启自适应递归可以达到阶为断裂后样本数分之一（1/n）的频率差距，但该差距对下一区间没有任何约束作用。在一次较大的合成变点之后，重启分位数在第50次预测时的覆盖率误差为0.035，而五个自适应基线中最好者为0.052。在每次合成变点之后的前50次预测中，重启递归都具有最小的频率差距。真实变点大多是……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文证明预先公告的结构性变点使“下一区间的保形可靠性”与“封闭窗口的频率校准”这两种重置审计目标可以分离，并提出在公告时点重启经验分位数与自适应递归的方法，前者达到1/√n的minimax可靠性速率、后者达到1/n的频率差距，且实验中覆盖率误差显著优于自适应基线（0.035对0.052）。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that announced structural breaks separate next-interval conformal reliability from closed-window frequency calibration: restarting the empirical quantile at the announced date attains the minimax reliability rate of order 1/√n, while a restarted adaptive recursion attains a frequency gap of order 1/n that bounds nothing about the next interval, and experiments show the restarted quantile achieves lower coverage error (0.035 vs 0.052) than the best adaptive baseline.
